messages:
satoshi: Quick heads-up — ran int8 bringup for kestrel-lite-v2 and seeing large BLEU drop on zh->en newsdev (~25.4 fp16 -> 18.6 int8). Looks like token alignment mismatch for shared Han characters.
maria: ugh. can you share model + quant + tokenizer details?
satoshi: model=kestrel-lite-v2 (v2026-03-20), quant=per-channel int8, calibration=wiki-1k, tokenizer=shared_han_unigram_40k.model (artifact pulled from onboarding bucket).
maria: did the tokenizer artifact change recently? @lee any generator runs last week?
lee: we regenerated a shared_han model during the vocab cleanup PR but I thought it was just extra_symbols reordering. i'll diff the artifacts.
satoshi: repro command i ran:```
python infra/eval/translate.py --model kestrel-lite-v2 --quant int8 --tokenizer artifacts/shared_han_unigram_40k.model --src zh --tgt en --split newsdev
```
results summary: fp16 BLEU=25.4, int8 BLEU=18.6 (same eval harness).
ana: that's massive. often means subtokenization boundaries moved -> shift in alignment and ngram scoring.
lee: confirmed: the tokenizer file in onboarding-artifacts at HEAD has a different symbol ordering vs the one used in the fp16 baseline. some multi-char han subtokens got new ids. seems the artifact regen used a different random seed. PR #1123 touched generator script.
satoshi: that matches: int8 pipeline image was built after the artifact bump, so the int8 eval used the new tokenizer binary. quant code didn't change tokenizer behavior but artifact drift would cause id mismatch.
maria: action plan: (1) rollback tokenizer artifact used by int8 pipeline to previous commit (abc123) and rerun shadow-eval; (2) add token-id parity check into bringup CI; (3) make tokenizer generation deterministic and record seed in metadata.
lee: opened PR to pin artifact in bringup config and added test that compares token ids for the 500 most common han chars. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/eng/tokenizer-pin/ + diff in pipeline yaml.
ana: I'll run shadow eval on Dedicated GPU pool (queueing now) — ETA ~40m.
devops-bot: shadow-eval job queued on dedicated/gpu-pool-2 (job id=8421)
eval-bot: shadow-eval job 8421 started
eval-bot: shadow-eval job 8421 finished — zh->en BLEU (with rollback to abc123 tokenizer) = 25.1; previous int8 run (new artifact) was 18.6.
satoshi: nice — that confirms artifact drift is the likely root cause. kv-cache ordering/kernel differences still worth auditing but token id drift explains the large BLEU gap.
maria: closing immediate regression. follow-ups: lea (@lee) to make tokenizer generation deterministic + record seed; satoshi to add token-id parity gate in bringup CI; ana to add a Console rollout guard that flags tokenizer artifact changes during deploys.
lee: added deterministic seed to generator and uploaded new artifact with seed recorded in metadata (seed=20260320). patch will prevent silent id shifts. PR link in my earlier comment.
satoshi: i'll slip a small unit into quant bringup that checks token-id parity for a canonical han sample before accepting a run.
maria: thanks all. lesson: tokenizer artifacts are part of the runtime contract — pin them in build images. :thumbsup:
satoshi: filing follow-on ticket to audit kvcache/kernel ordering on int8 path (might reduce flakiness), but low priority now.
ana: noted and created ticket INF-2247 for kernel/kvcache audit.
maria: great. reassigning ownership: lee (deterministic tokenizer), satoshi (CI parity gate), ana (rollout guard). closing thread once PRs merge. :tada:
